elstyleSaver.innerContent:
By entering my name below and submitting this form
I certify that:
  1. I have read OCC’s Remote Work Policy and Procedures and work rules, and agree to abide by all their provisions.
  2. I have reviewed expectations and communication requirements in my remote- work plan and security requirements for remote work with my supervisor.
  3. I have agreed to establish a remote workspace at the location identified above and certify that my remote work site is safe and secure.
I understand that:
  1. I must follow all College policies and work rules. Failure to follow policies and work rules may result in disciplinary action and termination of remote work.
  2. I will promptly notify my supervisor if I need to change any term of this agreement so that a revised agreement can be entered.
  3. Reimbursement for travel and meals will not be available to me for work at an authorized remote work location.
  4. If approved to use a privately-owned phone or device during remote work, my device may be subject to discovery under court rules, court orders or litigation holds, acceptable-use or cyber-security incident investigations by OCC, and Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests.
I further understand that:
  1. This Remote Work Agreement can be ended by the appointing authority any time for any reason and that I can end this agreement. If feasible, when ending a Remote Work Agreement, two weeks' notice will be given.
